aadhaar_number.title: Aadhaar Number
aadhaar_number.description: Unmasked 12-digit Aadhaar number, grouped as `XXXX XXXX XXXX`.

masked_aadhaar_number.title: Masked Aadhaar Number
masked_aadhaar_number.description: Masked number such as `XXXX XXXX 1234`, when that is all the card shows.

aadhaar_number_valid.title: Aadhaar Number Valid
aadhaar_number_valid.description: Verhoeff checksum result for an unmasked Aadhaar number.

mobile_number.title: Mobile Number
mobile_number.description: Indian mobile number in E.164 format, when printed on the document.

care_of.title: Care Of
care_of.description: Relationship/name printed as C/O, S/O, D/O, or W/O.

vid.title: Vid
vid.description: 16-digit Virtual ID, grouped in blocks of four.

AadhaarData.title: AadhaarData
AadhaarData.description: Structured values printed on the front and back of an Aadhaar card.

customer_password.title: Customer Password
customer_password.description: Password the customer uses to log into the dashboard.

allowed_ocr_modes.title: Allowed Ocr Modes
allowed_ocr_modes.description: OCR products this key may invoke.

customer_reused.title: Customer Reused
customer_reused.description: True if the customer already existed and was reused.

key.title: Key
key.description: Plaintext API key — shown ONCE at creation, never again.

dashboard_password.title: Dashboard Password
dashboard_password.description: Dashboard password when it was generated or reset by this request.

ClientJobQueueStats.title: ClientJobQueueStats
ClientJobQueueStats.description: Active queue counts scoped to the authenticated key or client account.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Personal websites — URLs not classified into linkedin/github/social.

address.title: Address
address.description: Mailing / correspondence address as a single string, preserving comma separators. Filled by the LLM fallback when present; the heuristic parser does not attempt this.

whatsapp.title: Whatsapp
whatsapp.description: WhatsApp contact number when the CV prints it as a separate field ("WhatsApp: +91…", "WhatsApp Number"). Common on Indian / Gulf-application CVs where it is distinct from the primary phone.

location.title: Location
location.description: Work location as printed on the CV (e.g. 'Chennai, India', 'Dubai, UAE', 'Riyadh, Saudi Arabia'). Used to split total experience into Indian vs Overseas buckets.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country of the work location, normalized to a single token (e.g. 'India', 'UAE', 'Saudi Arabia', 'USA'). When the CV only shows a city, the LLM infers the country. Drives the is_overseas flag.

is_overseas.title: Is Overseas
is_overseas.description: True when the job is outside India. Derived from country: country == 'India' (or matches an Indian state/city) → False; any other country → True. Unknown country defaults to False (counted as Indian).

duration_human.title: Duration Human
duration_human.description: Human-formatted duration, e.g. "1 year 6 months", "3 years 0 months", "8 months". Recomputed by the orchestrator after the LLM returns — never trust an LLM-supplied value here.

mrz_source.title: Mrz Source
mrz_source.description: Where the values in `mrz` came from. `mrz` = ICAO MRZ band parsed with check-digit validation. `visual` = recovered from the visible bio fields when the MRZ band could not be detected (typical on phone-camera scans with glare or cropped edges). Visual data has no checksums, so `all_check_digits_valid` is always false and `confidence` reflects the fraction of expected fields recovered.

raw_mrz.title: Raw Mrz
raw_mrz.description: The raw multi-line MRZ string as detected on the document. Always null when `mrz_source` is `visual`.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Structured fields extracted from the visible (non-MRZ) printed text on every uploaded page — covers bio-page details and back-page entries like Father's Name, Mother's Name, Spouse, Address, Place of Issue, File Number, Old Passport Number.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Per-page OCR output for every page that was scanned — raw text, lines, words with bounding boxes, and confidence. Useful to verify the back side of a passport actually got OCR'd, and to fall back to raw text when a label isn't covered by `fields`.

category.title: Category
category.description: Grouping bucket — e.g. Personal, Family, Document, Employment, Salary, Other. The set is open-ended; new buckets can be added by extending the per-endpoint label dictionary.

HistoryDetail.title: HistoryDetail
HistoryDetail.description: A history record including the full parsed result JSON.

HistoryItem.title: HistoryItem
HistoryItem.description: A single history record without the (potentially large) result body.

IpaDetails.title: IpaDetails
IpaDetails.description:
Structured fields from a Singapore MOM IPA letter (Employer's Copy or
Pass Holder's Copy, incl. the Declaration Form pages).

Every field is optional: a given copy prints only a subset (e.g. CSN and
Monthly Levy appear on the Employer's Copy; the residential address only on
the Employer's Copy; Work Address only on the Pass Holder's Copy). Absent
fields are ``None``. Values are returned as printed (no date/number
normalization) — ``period_granted_months`` is the only coerced field.

PassportDetails.title: PassportDetails
PassportDetails.description:
Passport / travel-document fields when listed on the CV.

Common on CVs for migrant workers (Gulf, SE Asia) where the passport
is part of the application package. All optional.

date_of_birth.title: Date Of Birth
date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as printed on the CV (e.g. "10/12/1992", "15 Jan 1990"). Kept as a string so the original format survives — different templates use different conventions.

gender.title: Gender
gender.description: Gender as printed ("Male", "Female", "Other", or as written).

languages_known.title: Languages Known
languages_known.description: Languages the candidate speaks/reads/writes, as listed on the CV. Order preserved. Free-text rather than ISO codes so the original phrasing survives (e.g. 'English', 'Tamil', 'Malayalam', 'Arabic').

PersonalInfo.title: PersonalInfo
PersonalInfo.description:
Biographical fields commonly printed on Indian-style form CVs.

All optional — most resumes outside that template won't have any of
these populated, and the response will carry an empty PersonalInfo
block in that case. UI callers should hide the section when every
field is None / empty.

designation.title: Designation
designation.description: Current / most recent job title (e.g. 'Senior Software Engineer'). Derived from the latest experience entry — null when the CV carries no employment history.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Primary industry sector the candidate has worked in (e.g. 'Information Technology', 'Construction', 'Oil & Gas', 'Healthcare'). Inferred by the LLM from companies and job descriptions; null when the CV doesn't make this evident.

highest_qualification.title: Highest Qualification
highest_qualification.description: Highest academic qualification (e.g. 'Bachelor of Engineering', 'MBA', 'Master of Computer Application'). Picked by ranking the education entries; null when no education is listed.

indian_experience_months.title: Indian Experience Months
indian_experience_months.description: Sum of experience months for jobs located in India.

overseas_experience_months.title: Overseas Experience Months
overseas_experience_months.description: Sum of experience months for jobs located outside India.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: Awards, honours, scholarships, competition results, academic ranks, and other accomplishments stated on the resume.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Certifications, licences, diplomas, completed workshops, and training credentials stated on the resume.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Page text transcribed directly by the vision LLM. Resume mode does not run an OCR engine, so lines is empty and average_confidence is 0.0 rather than a fabricated OCR score.
